# INSIGHTS — summarized, verified findings (accumulate across the whole run)

The JOURNAL is your per-iteration diary; THIS file is the distilled, VERIFIED takeaway a future iteration should read instead of re-reading the whole journal or old sessions/traces. Update it whenever you have a genuinely NEW, confirmed finding (an accepted/rejected RESULT counts as confirmation; a guess does not) — not every iteration needs a new entry. Structure each addition as:

    ## <task or mechanism name>
    - What worked (confirmed by a RESULT, cite the candidate id):
    - What didn't (confirmed by a RESULT, cite the candidate id):
    - Promising but not yet tried:

## Wrong-reservation selection (tasks 17/22) — the always-failing cluster
- What worked (verified by direct DB execution, cand_0003): a DETERMINISTIC `find_reservation(user_id, origin, destination)` resolver with a metro-area alias map ({JFK,LGA,EWR}↔"New York"/"Newark"/…) returns EXACTLY the route-matching reservation (NY→Chicago→['FQ8APE'] only). RESULT pending.
- What didn't (cand_0002 REJECTED): `list_reservations(user_id)` that only SURFACES routes in city terms — it still required the weak mid-tier reader to reason "Chicago = ORD" and pick. Rejected on significance (Δ+0.083, broke nothing). Lesson: for a weak runtime reader, DECIDE in code, don't hand it structured data to reason over.
- Promising but not yet tried: if find_reservation also under-moves, fold the resolver INTO the write tools (update/cancel accept origin/destination and self-resolve the id) so a wrong id can't be passed at all.

## Cancel eligibility (task 37 + cancel tasks)
- What worked (verified cand_0003): full in-body eligibility gate in cancel_reservation — flown-segment guard + (booked_within_24h OR business OR insurance OR airline_cancelled) — REFUSES IFOYYZ/NQNU5R, PASSES gold cancels Z7GOZK(insurance)/K1NW8N(within-24h). Key: «redacted» created_at/current_dt with datetime.fromisoformat(str(...)) and set the except-fallback to booked_within_24h=TRUE (conservative) so a parse hiccup never over-refuses a gold cancel. RESULT pending.
- What didn't (cand_0002): flown-segment guard ALONE — too narrow; didn't catch ineligible-but-not-flown cancels. Made bigger this iteration per the "POWER/SIZE not redesign" verdict.
- Confirmed: cancel_reservation takes no `reason` arg, so insurance-reason coverage can't be code-checked — that sliver stays in prose.

## Significance bar behavior (mechanism)
- Confirmed by RESULT: a candidate can improve val by +0.083 and break ZERO passing tasks yet be REJECTED (cand_0002) — the gate needs per-task delta above ~2·SE. When rejected with broke={—}, the correct response is KEEP the edits and amplify the effect (bigger/more-deterministic), NOT redesign on the unresolved list (which "moved less than 2·SE" ≠ "was touched by the edit").
